scene: The savory dumpling bites back with spicy bean chili.
picture: Flat pixel-art side view along a brick street. On the far left, a vendor beside a wooden food cart offers a blue porcelain teapot. In the centre, the bearded man in his blue cap and orange cardigan holds his cane, puffing steam from his mouth. Up high hangs the orange goldfish kite with a golden dangling string. On the far right, the open doorway glows warm yellow.
